idea-plugin.description:
Build, run and deploy apps and watchfaces for Pebble smartwatches — in C or in Alloy (JavaScript and TypeScript) — in IntelliJ IDEA, CLion and WebStorm.

The plugin drives the official Pebble SDK and pebble-tool; it does not replace them. This early version finds the SDK, checks that everything a build needs is installed, and installs or activates an SDK for you. Code insight, building, the emulator inside the IDE, installing on a watch and logs are on the way.

Getting started

  1. Install pebble-tool: uv tool install pebble-tool.
  2. Open a folder whose package.json has a pebble section.
  3. If the SDK is missing, the editor says so and offers to install it. Tools | Pebble | Check Environment shows everything at once.

action.description: Shows whether pebble-tool, an SDK and its toolchain are installed
